verdict.rationale: Featurebase shows some support for attribute-based segmentation (docs-6) and AI-assisted prioritization/decluttering (docs-7), suggesting some capacity to layer customer data onto feedback, but there is no direct evidence of a feature showing customer profile/context (e.g., plan tier, company, revenue, submitter identity) directly alongside feedback posts for prioritization. missing for 10: explicit customer profile/CRM enrichment shown alongside feedback items, voter/segment breakdown UI, integration with customer data sources (e.g., Salesforce/HubSpot) surfaced in feedback view.
